source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[Bank_Code]
				,CC.[Source_System]
				,CC.[Data_Mart_Field]
				,CC.[BM_Field_Name]
				,CC.[Code]
				,CC.[Description]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES CC
		--	JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES B 
        --    ON CC.Code = B.Code
        --    AND CC.Data_Mart_Field = B.Data_Mart_Field
         --   AND CC.Bank_Code = B.Bank_Code
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.Code,'-1') = COALESCE(B.Code,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.Data_Mart_Field,'-1') = COALESCE(B.Data_Mart_Field,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.Bank_Code,'-1') = COALESCE(B.Bank_Code,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1




INSERT INTO EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES
(
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST
				,BNK_CODE
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME 
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'CCD'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
